shellCommands.command: /bin/bash -lc 'git status --short && cat package.json && for p in /AGENTS.md /workspace/AGENTS.md; do if [ -f "$p" ]; then cat "$p"; fi; done'
/bin/bash -lc 'find app lib -name AGENTS.md -print && cat app/page.tsx app/product/page.tsx lib/data.ts next.config.ts app/layout.tsx tsconfig.json && git diff -- package.json'

/bin/bash -lc "rg -n 'prefetch' node_modules/next/cache.d.ts node_modules/next/server.d.ts node_modules/next/dist/server/app-render -g '*.d.ts' && cat node_modules/next/cache.d.ts && cat node_modules/next/package.json | head -35"
/bin/bash -lc "git diff --check && git diff -- app/page.tsx app/product/page.tsx next.config.ts && rg --files node_modules | rg '/(playwright|puppeteer)(-core)?/package.json"'$'"'"
/bin/bash -lc 'git status --short && git diff -- tsconfig.json && cat .gitignore && rg --files .next/server/app | head -65'

/bin/bash -lc "git show HEAD:tsconfig.json > tsconfig.json node --input-type=module <<'JS' import assert from 'node:assert/strict' import { readFileSync, rmSync } from 'node:fs' const html = readFileSync('.next/server/app/product.html', 'utf8') for (const content of [ '

Premium Widget

', '

A durable widget for everyday projects.

', '

Related products

', '
  • Compact Widget
    • ', '
  • Widget Carry Case
    • ', ]) assert.ok(html.includes(content), "'`Missing prerendered content: ${content}`) console.log('"'Production HTML check passed: product details and both related products render on direct visits.') rmSync('.next', { recursive: true }) rmSync('next-env.d.ts') JS git diff --check && git status --short"
